subject: Proposal CPI/2026/00512 — Conditional Approval
body:
Proposal Number: CPI/2026/00512
Insured: Suryodaya Petrochem Industries Pvt. Ltd.
Broker: Vikram Risk & Insurance Advisors LLP

Dear Vikram Risk & Insurance Advisors LLP,

We are pleased to confirm conditional approval of Proposal CPI/2026/00512 for Suryodaya Petrochem Industries Pvt. Ltd., subject to the following conditions:
  - Client to submit a detailed fire safety audit report from an approved third-party agency within 90 days. This must include recommendations for upgrading the fire protection system, especially in process and storage areas.
  - Client to provide a timeline and plan for addressing the aged wiring in the process area within 60 days. This should include a commitment to upgrade the electrical system to current safety standards.
  - Client to present a comprehensive flood mitigation plan, including details on drainage improvements and any proposed structural enhancements, within 120 days.
  - Installation of automatic sprinkler systems in process and storage areas, with a detailed project plan submitted within 180 days and completion within 1 year.
  - Enhanced security measures, including interior CCTV coverage for critical process and storage areas, to be completed within 90 days.

Regards,
Underwriting Team, Commercial Property Division
reason: The risk presents material hazards (chemical manufacturing, flammable liquids, aged wiring) and high CAT exposure (flood zone A with historical events). The human underwriter identified these severe risks, and the case was escalated for review. Although the TIV exceeds my standard delegated authority, as a senior underwriter, I have the final authority to approve, reject, or request further review the case. The proposed 25% premium loading reflects the significant risks involved. Given the high-hazard industry and the identified deficiencies, additional risk mitigation measures are necessary to ensure the insurability of this account.
